$comment: Format presets for the ProductTank capture. Not part of the engine lock (its schema has no formats key); tools/render-batch.mjs and the templates read this file. Sizes are MTP's own template sizes where a reference exists (DEC-004).

social-landscape.use: LinkedIn link card, Facebook, Meetup event photo

story.use: Instagram / LinkedIn stories, WhatsApp status; keep content out of the top 250 px and bottom 300 px

event-banner.use: LinkedIn event / Meetup cover, deck cover

badge-a6.use: event name badge, A6 portrait at 300 dpi, no bleed (DEC-016)

flyer-a6.use: A6 print flyer with bleed: 111 x 154 mm at 300 dpi, trims to 105 x 148 mm (35 px bleed each side), keep copy 35 px inside the trim (DEC-019)

flyer-a6-landscape.use: A6 print flyer, landscape, with bleed: 154 x 111 mm at 300 dpi, trims to 148 x 105 mm (DEC-019)
